CustomField.label: How To Interpret Query Results
CustomField.description: Required for Check records with a query and Compare two queries checks. Tells Record Health Check whether to expect one result, evaluate any matching record, evaluate every matching record, or compare query results as lists. For COUNT(), SUM(), and other aggregate queries, choose Expect one row or aggregate result.

value.label: Expect one row or aggregate result
At least one record must pass

CustomField.inlineHelpText: Expect one row or aggregate result = one row, COUNT(), or SUM(). At least one record must pass = any record passing is enough. Every record must pass = all records must pass. Compare query results as lists = needed for list operators and Compare two queries.
